comments.text: function: BASIC loader stub (10 SYS 2064) plus 3 zero-padding bytes, handing control to start at $0810 on RUN | inputs: none | outputs: none | side effects: none -- pure data, never executed

function: demonstrates that $D020 means different things under different $01 bank states -- writes it under $37 (I/O in, real border colour), $34 (I/O out, plain RAM write), reads it under $34 (plain RAM read), then copies 256 bytes from $D000,x (Character ROM under $33) to $3000,x before restoring $01=$37 | inputs: none | outputs: none in registers | side effects: writes $01 four times ($37,$34,$33,$37), writes $D020 twice, reads $D020 once, copies 256 bytes $D000-$D0FF to $3000-$30FF via the cpchar loop, re-enables interrupts (cli)
